summary: BUG: Error When Attempting to Review & Invoice Work Order S-1101
reported_issue: User received an error when attempting to Review and Invoice Work Order S-1101; the system prevented the WO from moving forward in the invoicing process. NOTE: the part price is $0.
expected_after_fix: The work order should successfully move to Review and allow invoicing without errors, even when a part price is $0.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin. The reported WO (S-1101, Ed Rose Trucking) is an account-specific record not present on staging, so I reproduced the underlying scenario: a work order containing a part with sell price $0.
Located an in-workplace WO with a $0-sell-price received part (S12-24601) via the lines API.
Opened its Finance tab in the real SPA and let the invoice pipeline run; captured the invoice-details and estimate/PDF endpoint responses.

Also attempted a full UI Review -> Create Invoice on a WO; the Create Invoice button stays disabled until review/parts-received gating is satisfied, which the automated harness could not fully complete.
Confirmed my raw direct-API estimate calls returned 500 for ALL WOs (including ones with no $0 parts) due to an incomplete payload — a red herring, not the reported bug.
actual_now: For the WO containing a $0-price part (S12-24601), the invoicing pipeline works: GET /api/invoices/{id}/details returned 200 (this is the margin/financials computation), and POST /api/work-orders/invoices/estimate returned 200 twice — generating both the invoice HTML and the PDF. No 500, no DivisionByZeroError, and no error rendered on the Finance page. The margin computation that involves the $0-price part completed successfully.
notes: Could not click the final 'Create Invoice' button end-to-end because it stays disabled behind review/received-parts gating that the harness couldn't drive; however the margin-computing invoice-details + estimate/PDF generation (exactly where the original error occurred) now processes a $0-price part with HTTP 200. Original WO S-1101 is a customer account record not available on staging. Marked FIXED (v0.54.hotfix-1) with medium confidence.
